answer: The anchor counter is kept in velvet and ridge publishes each reset. An hostile operator hence has to keep each alias continuously active for 19 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 19 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 1226 identities would post 1888 proofs and burn roughly 49 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
